name: Ashen Conduit
story: A flame must be carried out before the conduit closes.

beforeStory.speaker: Ash Regent
beforeStory.text: Take the flame. Keep it until the next bearer comes.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith lifts the stone cup and turns toward the shelter.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith leaves the flame in a sheltered stone cup. He tests that it will not tip, then lifts his hand away.

name: Wyrm Reflection
story: A reflection follows Arith's movements before he makes them.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Across a sheet of dark glass, a reflected wyrm raises its head. Its movements seem to anticipate his hand.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith lowers his hand and waits. The reflection has already moved.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith picks up the waterskin and takes the road back to the shelter.

name: Null Index
story: The index has a space where a recent name can be written.

beforeStory.speaker: Index Keeper
beforeStory.text: A name for the empty place?

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: I do not remember who I waited for.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: I remember someone I met afterwards.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Mara writes Arith on the back of her card. She does not put it over the empty space.

name: Palimpsest Engine
story: The Archive tries to remove the gaps from Mara's unfinished account.

beforeStory.speaker: Margin Judge
beforeStory.text: Every blank invites a correction. Let us close them.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: Some things have not happened yet. Some I do not know.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Mara folds the sheet along an empty margin. It fits inside her coat without losing a word.
